name: Broken Alliances
summary: Gorn sends you from Kargath to reclaim what the ogres took. He seeks to restore the Horde’s honor after its alliance with Deathwing. Boss Tho’grun, hired to find the Sign of the Earth, betrayed the Horde and kept it.

sections.title: A Hired Band Turns
sections.body:
During the Second War, the Horde fought beside Deathwing. His lieutenants Blacklash and Hematus were later imprisoned far to the east in Lethlor Ravine. Gorn believes these old, depraved allies must be silenced to restore the Horde’s honor.

The Horde needed the Sign of the Earth to open the drakes’ prison, so it hired ogre mercenaries led by Boss Tho’grun to find the sign. Tho’grun turned against the Horde, overwhelmed its forces and kept it.

sections.title: Camp Boff
sections.body: Gorn sends you southeast of Kargath to Camp Boff. Kill Tho’grun and bring back the Sign of the Earth. Gorn will be glad to see Tho’grun dead. The ogres no longer belong to the Horde.

sections.title: What the Sign Opens
sections.body:
Gorn expects the ogres to fall into disarray after Tho’grun’s death. That will be a small victory, and may lead to a larger one.

With the Sign of the Earth in Horde hands, the black drakes’ prison in Lethlor can be opened. They will be freed from endless imprisonment, only to meet their doom.

faq.answer: Gorn is a Horde figure in Kargath who sends you after the Sign of the Earth. He wants to restore the Horde’s honor by silencing its depraved allies of old.

faq.q: Why does Gorn want Boss Tho'grun dead?
faq.answer: The Horde hired Boss Tho’grun and his ogre mercenaries to obtain the Sign of the Earth. Tho’grun betrayed them, overwhelmed them and kept the sign.
Camp Boff lies southeast of Kargath.

faq.q: What is the Sign of the Earth?
aliases: what does sign of the earth do
faq.answer: The Sign of the Earth is a key needed to open the drakes’ prison in Lethlor Ravine.

faq.q: Which dragons are imprisoned in Lethlor Ravine?
faq.answer: Blacklash and Hematus are two of Deathwing’s lieutenants. They were imprisoned in Lethlor Ravine after the Horde fought beside Deathwing during the Second War.
